title: Built-Skin Innovations: Smart Facades
summary: A modular, IoT-based façade canopy for Indian buildings, a "power suit" that cuts cooling demand, heat and street noise in one customisable system.
points: Thermal insulation plus Helmholtz-resonator and meta-material sound absorbers in one panel
Sensors track temperature, wind speed and air quality, and automate irrigation for drought-resistant creeper plants
Modular and customisable, designed for India's summers and monsoon, with a scaffold-free install
